AnchoredPoint.description: A point in a parent view's projection plane (part mm, origin at the projected part origin, x right, y up): free, or following a projected entity (a hole centre). An unresolved ref is needs attention, never a guess.

AnnotationPlacement.description: How one view shows one annotation. The drawing stores this, never a copy of the annotation. At most one placement per (view, annotation); the import never places an annotation twice in a drawing (a second placement is allowed by hand and listed as a duplicate).

text.description: Text shift along the dimension line from its auto-centred position, sheet mm (ADR-055 rules).

witness.description: Witness (extension) lines: mirror to the other end; hide one or both.

configurationId.description: Configuration override (badged in the UI): absent = the drawing's; `null` = Default; an id = that configuration. A missing id is needs attention (never a fall-back, trap T13).

display.description: Absent fields inherit (parent, or `style.view` for base views).

centerMarks.description: Automatic centre marks on circles seen face-on, centre lines on cylinders seen side-on.

threads.description: Cosmetic threads (thin lines per ISO 6410 / ASME Y14.6).

label.description: Label override; absent = derived (`SECTION A–A`, `DETAIL B (2:1)`, none for base).

rotation.description: In-plane rotation, an angle `Expr` (CCW). Children re-derive from it.

scale.description: Unitless ratio `1/2`, `2`. Absent: base and iso views use the sheet's scale; projected and section views their parent's. Detail views must set it.

CenterMark.description: Manually added centre marks and lines (automatic ones come from `ViewDisplay`).

refs.description: Circles / cylinders (mark, bolt circle) or two edges (centre line between them).

DetailView.description: Enlarged detail of a circle on the parent. `radius` in part mm (stable under scale changes).

configurationId.description: Configuration override (badged in the UI): absent = the drawing's; `null` = Default; an id = that configuration. A missing id is needs attention (never a fall-back, trap T13).

scale.description: Unitless ratio `1/2`, `2`. Absent: base and iso views use the sheet's scale; projected and section views their parent's. Detail views must set it.

Drawing.description: A drawing (one file, `drawings/<slug>.drawing.json`). Flat, id-keyed collections reference their sheet or view by id, so moving a view between sheets or a placement between views is one leaf edit for the merge. Order carries meaning only for `sheets` (sheet numbering); every other collection is kept sorted by id. No derived data: HLR output, resolved values, the frame and title block and table rows are computed and cached in `.wren/` (PLAN §8A.1).

configurationId.description: The drawing's configuration, inherited by views, tables and title block; absent = Default.

projection.description: Explicit (trap T4), never implied by the sheet size or the standard.

DrawingHoleTable.description: Hole table on demand: one row per hole instance of the listed hole features (or all) as seen in `viewId`, X/Y from `origin`, size from the feature's callout. Tags (A1, A2 …) are derived in a deterministic order and drawn at each hole in the view.

position.description: The `anchor` corner's sheet position, sheet mm.

DrawingStandard.description: The drawing's standard family and editions (shown in the title block, used for validation).

generalTolerance.description: General tolerance note, e.g. `ISO 2768-mK`; absent = none stated.

gps.description: Must belong to `family` (ISO 1101 with iso, ASME Y14.5 with asme).

DrawingStyle.description: Every visual quantity of a drawing, in sheet mm, independent of view scale (trap T8): a 1:20 view has the same 1.5 mm extension overshoot as a 1:1 view. Created from the standard's preset (ISO defaults = ADR-055: 1 mm gap, 1.5 mm overshoot) and stored in full, so an app update never changes a drawing that is already made; "reset to preset" is an ordinary edit.

firstLane.description: Distance from the view's outline to snap lane 0, and between lanes.

textOrientation.description: ISO: text aligned with the dimension line; ASME: unidirectional (horizontal).

textPosition.description: ISO: above the line; ASME: in a break of the line.

font.description: Font id from the bundled set (D5), e.g. `osifont`.

view.description: Display defaults for new base views (dependent views inherit their parent's).

DrawingSubject.description: M4 drawings show one part; M6 adds `{ kind: 'assembly' }`.

GpsStandard.description: Standard an annotation's GD&T semantics are validated against. Stamped by the authoring tool from the drawing (or, in M5, the project default); absent on an annotation = "not stated", and it is then checked against each displaying drawing's standard. Never converted silently: a symbol that is illegal under the standard is refused or flagged with an explanation (ASME Y14.5-2018 has no concentricity or symmetry).

IsoView.description: Isometric view derived from a parent (rotating the parent re-derives it).

configurationId.description: Configuration override (badged in the UI): absent = the drawing's; `null` = Default; an id = that configuration. A missing id is needs attention (never a fall-back, trap T13).

display.description: Absent fields inherit (parent, or `style.view` for base views).

centerMarks.description: Automatic centre marks on circles seen face-on, centre lines on cylinders seen side-on.

threads.description: Cosmetic threads (thin lines per ISO 6410 / ASME Y14.6).

label.description: Label override; absent = derived (`SECTION A–A`, `DETAIL B (2:1)`, none for base).

scale.description: Unitless ratio `1/2`, `2`. Absent: base and iso views use the sheet's scale; projected and section views their parent's. Detail views must set it.

LineGroupId.description: Line group: thick/thin widths in mm. ISO 128 series groups (thick/thin 1:2) and the ASME Y14.2 preset (0.6/0.3). One renderer maps line roles to widths for SVG, PDF and DXF alike.

Markup.description: Review markup (D8, recommended): local-first, in the project, pinned to the version it was drawn on. Never exported or released; merges as an append-mostly set.

anchor.description: What it is about, when it was drawn on something (survives revisions).

PartPropertiesTable.description: Part properties table (owner D3): one row for the drawing's configuration, or one row per listed configuration (`null` = Default) for tabulated drawings. Values come from the resolved configuration (mass from its background build, ADR-079); never stored. BOM: M6.

position.description: The `anchor` corner's sheet position, sheet mm.

PlacementLayout.description: Placement intent, relative to the referenced geometry, in sheet mm (trap T8: never absolute). After a model change every placement keeps its lane or offset.

ProjectedView.description: Orthographic projection of the parent, seen from one of its sides.

configurationId.description: Configuration override (badged in the UI): absent = the drawing's; `null` = Default; an id = that configuration. A missing id is needs attention (never a fall-back, trap T13).

threads.description: Cosmetic threads (thin lines per ISO 6410 / ASME Y14.6).

from.description: The side of the parent the viewer looks from (`top` = top view of the parent).

label.description: Label override; absent = derived (`SECTION A–A`, `DETAIL B (2:1)`, none for base).

scale.description: Unitless ratio `1/2`, `2`. Absent: base and iso views use the sheet's scale; projected and section views their parent's. Detail views must set it.

RefPoint.description: Which point of a referenced entity an annotation measures from (parallel to `refs`). `self`: the entity itself (a face, an edge's line). `center`: circle, arc or sphere centre. `axis`: a cylindrical or conical face's axis. `start` / `end` / `mid`: of an edge.

SectionView.description: Section through the parent along an editable cut line: ≥ 2 points in the parent's projection plane; each segment is a cutting plane perpendicular to the parent view (2 points = full, more = offset/stepped; a half section is an L-shaped line). `look`: the viewer looks towards the left or right side of the line's direction (first → last point); arrows show it.

configurationId.description: Configuration override (badged in the UI): absent = the drawing's; `null` = Default; an id = that configuration. A missing id is needs attention (never a fall-back, trap T13).

depth.description: `full`: everything behind the cut; `slice`: the cut faces only.

display.description: Absent fields inherit (parent, or `style.view` for base views).

threads.description: Cosmetic threads (thin lines per ISO 6410 / ASME Y14.6).

label.description: Label override; absent = derived (`SECTION A–A`, `DETAIL B (2:1)`, none for base).

scale.description: Unitless ratio `1/2`, `2`. Absent: base and iso views use the sheet's scale; projected and section views their parent's. Detail views must set it.
Default scale for views on the sheet and the title block's scale: a unitless ratio `1/2`, `2`.

size.description: A named size, or a custom size in mm (no frame zones are generated for custom sizes).

SheetNote.description: Free text on a sheet (general notes). `{slot}` tokens resolve like title-block slots.

position.description: Top-left of the text box, sheet mm.

width.description: Wrap width, sheet mm; absent = no wrap.

SurfaceFinishStandard.description: Surface texture standard (default ISO 21920-1; ISO 1302 is legacy, kept for old drawings).

TemplateBinding.description: A generated template: `(sheet format, template) → frame, zones, centring and trim marks, title block`. ISO 5457 frame with an ISO 7200 title block, or an ASME Y14.1 sheet (ANSI A–E). Nothing of the frame is stored. `version` pins the generator's layout so an app update never moves a title block on an existing drawing; "re-apply template" moves it to the latest version. Custom (project) templates are P2 (open question in the .md).

centerMarks.description: Automatic centre marks on circles seen face-on, centre lines on cylinders seen side-on.

threads.description: Cosmetic threads (thin lines per ISO 6410 / ASME Y14.6).

ViewLayout.description: Where a view sits on its sheet.

ViewOrientation.description: Base and stand-alone orientations. Named ones use the viewport's standard view directions.
